question_evidence_quote: This week it welcomed 100 people per day but on Saturday it was visited by 200 people and on Sunday by 300.
observed_error: The response treats one regular day's $300 revenue as revenue for all regular days.
violated_condition: Regular-day revenue must include five days at 100 people per day and $3 per ticket.
error_description: The response calculates 100 × $3 correctly but assigns that one-day revenue to all regular days. The week contains five regular days besides Saturday and Sunday, so regular-day revenue requires a factor of five. Its weekly sum consequently includes only one regular day's receipts.
